anomalies.obs: On the EthernetAndPower sheet the DC barrel jack J6 has its center pin (1, 'center is positive' per the in-schematic note) tied to NET0021, and its switch pin (3) tied to NET0030. NET0030 is the BAT+ rail (it feeds IC2 VIN/EN and USB VBUS J2.1), while NET0021 is the battery-negative / BAT- line. The battery-isolation diode U11 is likewise oriented with its cathode on NET0030 and anode on NET0021, so the battery's own terminals end up on the swapped nets.
anomalies.exp: The specification's reference netlist requires J4.1 -> BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2 -> GND, J4.3 -> BAT-, i.e. the jack center must sit on the BAT+ node (NET0030) and the switch contact on BAT- (NET0021), with the series diode anode on the battery positive and cathode on BAT+.

Netlist: J4.1->BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2->GND (sleeve), J4.3->BAT- ... a1d9676 'Meshinger 1.0 rev B WARNING THE DC PLUG PINS ARE WRONG, SHORTS BATTERY!' followed by af0d263 'now with power switch'

anomalies.imp: With no DC plug inserted the jack's internal switch shorts pin 3 to pin 2 (GND); because pin 3 is wired to NET0030 = BAT+, the battery/adapter positive rail is shorted straight to ground (and the isolation diode is reverse-connected, so it no longer protects the cell). The board cannot power up and the cell/adapter is over-currented - exactly the 'SHORTS BATTERY' condition the spec says was fixed in rev D.

parsed.summary: The schematic's power section swaps the BAT+ and BAT- nets at the DC barrel jack (and the battery diode), recreating the documented 'DC plug pins are wrong, shorts battery' fault: the jack center pin sits on BAT- and the switch pin on BAT+, so with no plug the switch shorts BAT+ to GND. All component values and the EPD/keyboard/regulator topologies otherwise match the specification.
